uncensored.calibration: ARCH-EXACT, NOT CALIBRATION-VERIFIED (2026-10-10): myllmbox/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-hibrid48-uncensored (rev 572e216), hibrid48's own abliterated sibling - OrcaRouter's abliteration (one refusal direction removed from 149 residual writers), the same architectures, layer count, 262,144 window, MTP drafter and a byte-identical NVFP4 PLE table - REWRITTEN from the publisher's compressed-tensors into hibrid48's own ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION layout by deploy/sglang-27b-tp2/ct_to_modelopt.py (README-modelopt-conversion.md beside the weights), so it loads through the same kernels, config path and tp-rank views as the original. WHAT CHANGED: routed experts and lm_head keep their NVFP4 bytes (weight_scale_2 = 1/weight_global_scale, exact); the experts' per-expert input_scale is COPIED from hibrid48's same expert and projection - the publisher's build is weight-only and carries no activation statistics, so those scales are hibrid48's calibration, not this checkpoint's; the drafter's 507 experts whose w1 and w3 (silu and linear halves) carry different globals are folded exactly into down_proj; the 300 FP8 per-channel GDN/QSA/shared-expert linears are dequantised to BF16 (one bf16 rounding; +1.36 GiB a rank over the original, whose GDN is W4A16_NVFP4). Verified tensor-for-tensor against the source (ct_to_modelopt.py verify). WATCHED LOADING ON THIS ROW 2026-10-11, generation 193 (PLE split, every other setting the default): 'Model loading took 51.98 GiB' a rank, serving at 20:08:35Z, the boxes using 91.6/86.7 GiB against the estimate's 89.8/84.3 - the memory block is still the ORIGINAL's measurement, about 1.4 GiB a rank light for this checkpoint. Its earlier vLLM failures were NOT its layout: generations 183/184 (the publisher's compressed-tensors) and 190/191 (this rewrite) were killed by tp-rank's memory guard before the KV pool exactly as the ORIGINAL was in 192 - all five with the PLE table replicated (lb/tests/test_flash_next_ple_split.py).

traffic.source: Per rank, TP=2, derived 2026-10-30 (tests/test_tensorfold_bandwidth_model.py). WEIGHTS off nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 rev fc694b54's own shard headers (all 11 files read by HTTP range; total 132,639,846,394 B = the index's total_size; grouped in tests/fixtures/shape/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4.header-groups.json) under TensorFold's loader split (recipe be3ed857 patch 0003 zig/src/families/flashnext/cuda_weights.zig: 'DeltaNet key/value heads and attention q/kv heads by rank, out_proj / o_proj input columns, every expert and the shared expert at the rank's half of the intermediate width, lm_head ... by vocabulary, the rest replicated'; 'bf16 linears as stored'; the shared expert as bf16 tiles with fp32 unit scales, fp4Table): dense_read_bytes = split 3,319,893,376 (GDN in_proj_qkv/z/a/b, conv1d, out_proj; attention q/k/v/o; lm_head, halved) + replicated 1,512,352,768 (hyper-connections 1.27e9, router 0.13e9, indexer qk 0.04e9, PLE key/value 0.07e9, norms) + shared expert 266,035,200; routed_expert_bytes = the 48 layers' NVFP4 experts (U8 codes 60,397,977,600 + F8 block scales 7,549,747,200) halved; the per-expert fp32 globals (0.3 MB) uncharged. Not streamed: embed_tokens and the 51.2 GB FP8 n-gram table (gathered by token), the 0.90 GB vision tower (idle on text). Cross-check: streamed + embedding + half the n-gram table + half the drafter = 62.7 GiB a rank against the recipe's own 62.3 GiB (measurements.json weights_gib). SHAPES off the same revision's config.json (tests/fixtures/shape/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4.config.json): num_experts 512, num_experts_per_tok 10, layer_types 12 full_attention + 36 linear_attention, num_key_value_heads 2 x head_dim 256, indexer_budget 2048, indexer_compress_ratio 4, indexer_head_dim 128, GDN 16 key / 48 value heads x 128 x 128, linear_conv_kernel_dim 4. LAYOUTS off the engine (patch 0005 cuda_state.zig): an FP8 key row is head_dim e4m3 codes + its two fp32 scales + 8 pad bytes (kv8_pad 16), a value row head_dim codes — kRow + vRow = 528, the rank-0 start log's own 'fp8 KV cache, 528 bytes a position a layer'; pooled indexer keys bf16, one per 4 positions; a sequence's GDN state is fixedSizes' recurrent [36, 24, 128, 128] f32 + conv [36, 3, 5,120] bf16, folded in place each pass (gdn_multi.block: 'each tree first folding in its stream's last kept rows (in place)') — read and written once: state_transfers 2. kv_cache_dtype_bytes is the launch's (engine_args kv_cache_dtype fp8_e4m3; at_kv_cache_dtype re-prices it)

traffic.source: Per rank, TP=2, read 2026-10-03 (tests/test_sglang_bandwidth_model.py checks each against SGLang's own allocations). BYTES A PASS STREAMS, off the shard headers on box-c: target = the 64 layers of /srv/models/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 (16,891,248,640 B of 2-D+ tensors halved + 1,351,808 B of 1-D ones every rank holds) + half the NVFP4 lm_head (357,580,808) = 8,804,567,176; the embedding shard (1.27e9, gathered by token) and the vision tower (0.92e9, idle on text) are resident and never streamed, which is why memory.weights_gib (10.28 GiB, resident) is not this figure. draft = Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2's attention + MLP halved (QKV/MergedColumn/RowParallel in SGLang srt/models/dflash.py: 3,198,156,800 / 2) + its replicated fc, grouped convs and norms (396,372,480) + the target's lm_head shard its selector projects onto every pass (dflash.py:1097-1124) = 2,353,031,688; the selector's two 248,320 x 256 codebooks are gathered by candidate id. SGLang SHARDS the drafter ('Load weight end ... DFlash2DraftModel ... mem usage=2.25 GB' per rank), so memory.mtp_gib (3.58, the whole file) overstates it here. SHAPES, off the two config.json: 16 full-attention + 48 linear-attention (GDN) layers, 4 KV heads x 256, GDN 48 value heads x 128 x 128; drafter 5 sliding-attention layers, 8 KV heads x 128, sliding_window 2048. DTYPES are the launch's: tp-rank sglang_cmd passes --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 (1 B, the drafter's pool too) and --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 (2 B; the checkpoint says float32).
